Shame. And shame again. Stay far away
May 2026 • Family
Spoiler: never — and I mean never — go to this place. Zero stars!!!
Now, putting emotions aside and sticking to facts. The table was booked well in advance. I specifically requested a private room because I was hosting important guests and expected everything to be at a high level.
What I got was a shock. First, the elevator takes you to a different floor. Then — the “private room” is right next to the restroom. The room itself is embarrassing: bare walls, zero atmosphere, nothing that even remotely reflects Japanese culture except a random picture of sakura. It’s basically just a plain room with a table.
During dinner, there were constant loud noises — things banging and falling somewhere around us. It didn’t feel like a restaurant at all, more like sitting in a storage area. No music, no ambiance, nothing.
Service was terrible. Every single request had to be repeated 3–4 times. We ordered a bottle of wine — they took the order, disappeared for 16 minutes, came back with “sorry, it’s not available,” and immediately tried to push a bottle that was twice as expensive. Take it or leave it. Seriously?
It gets worse. We ordered sushi with shrimp. After 15 minutes — “sorry, we’re out of shrimp.” In a “Japanese restaurant,” you don’t have basic ingredients? How does that even happen?
Green tea — same story. “Not available”. Green f….g tea not available????!!!!!
Final verdict: completely ruined evening, awful atmosphere, and a level of service that’s simply unacceptable. An utterly unworthy place.
Shame. And shame again. Stay far away
